reference_measurement.meaning: Coarse image calibration of the valid ordinary right-arrow cell only; not a fitted outline or em measurement.

calibration: 40-unit shaft matches the authored pilot FractionRuleThickness=40. Root arrow has approximately 5-pixel shaft across 84-pixel ink width and 38-pixel overall height. Shared curved open heads retain that visual direction; chosen em dimensions are provisional optical engineering, not a pixel registration.
excluded_reason: Only the valid ordinary right-arrow cell is used as visual calibration. Other cells are not traced or adopted as geometry.
implementation: Reusable stroked cubic open head, rectangular shaft/bar, exact rotations and reflections, then boolean union. No stock font imports.
limitations: Normal and long finite lengths only; no MATH assemblies.
Head proportions, weight, spacing, and script behavior need actual working-size optical approval.
Harpoons and double arrows are authored grammar derivatives, not accepted raster fits.
double_shaft_join: Solve the shared head cubic at each shaft centerline and trim the complete stripe with the exact cubic interior; head half-stroke supplies controlled overlap, no free projecting butt ends.
